title: The specification's text
description: The draft and every released revision of the specification, each Markdown file of spec/ as an HTML fragment, as the build step exports them.

draft.description: The checkout's own spec/, served at /spec/draft/.

releases.description: Each released revision, from its spec-<M>.<m> tag, oldest first.

ref.description: The git ref the files were read at: the commit for the draft, the tag for a release.

path.description: The site's path of the revision, /spec/<revision>/.

files.description: The revision's Markdown files, spec/*.md, in byte order of the name.

path.description: The site's path of the file's page: the revision's path for README.md, and the revision's path, the name without .md and a slash for every other file.

title.description: The plain text of the file's first level-1 heading, or empty when it has none.

html.description: The file as an HTML fragment. A link to another file of the revision is a link to its page; any other relative link is a link to the file in the repository at ref.

id.description: The id the heading's element carries.
